title: Spatial identification of rural areas under urban sprawl pressure: Preventive land-use policy framework for Antalya (Turkey)
title_zh: 城市蔓延压力下乡村地区的空间识别：安塔利亚（土耳其）预防性土地利用政策框架
title_primary: 城市蔓延压力下乡村地区的空间识别：安塔利亚（土耳其）预防性土地利用政策框架
title_secondary: Spatial identification of rural areas under urban sprawl pressure: Preventive land-use policy framework for Antalya (Turkey)
authors: Sıla Balta, Meryem Atik
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban sprawl is a major spatial transformation process characterized by the unplanned expansion of urban areas into surrounding rural and natural landscapes. As a result, rural areas at the urban fringe are increasingly exposed to pressures driven by population growth, housing demand, and expanding transportation infrastructure, giving rise to hybrid “rurban” landscapes. Managing these areas requires not only monitoring land use change but also identifying zones at risk of transformation before irreversible change occurs.Since the 1980s, Antalya has experienced rapid population growth, tourism-driven economic expansion, and largely uncoordinated development, leading to significant changes in surrounding agricultural and rural landscapes. This study develops a Geographic Information System (GIS) and remote sensing–based spatial analysis framework to systematically identify rural areas under urban sprawl pressure. The approach integrates the direction and intensity of urban expansion with existing rural land use patterns to examine their spatial interactions.Using multi-temporal satellite imagery within a GIS environment, the spatio-temporal dynamics of urban growth were analyzed and rural areas with high susceptibility to urban encroachment were delineated. The results show that the impacts of urban sprawl extend beyond existing built-up areas and are increasingly concentrated in transitional rural zones that remain unurbanized yet are critical for planning.The identified spatial patterns provide a basis for an early warning framework to support the protection of agricultural land and the development of preventive land use policies. Although tested in Antalya, the proposed framework is transferable to regions experiencing similar urbanization dynamics.
abstract_zh: 城市蔓延是一种主要的空间转型过程，其特征是城市区域无计划地向周边乡村和自然景观扩张。因此，城市边缘的乡村地区日益面临由人口增长、住房需求和交通基础设施扩展所驱动的压力，催生了城乡融合的“半城市化”景观。管理这些区域不仅需要监测土地利用变化，还需在不可逆变化发生前识别面临转型风险的区域。自20世纪80年代以来，安塔利亚经历了快速的人口增长、旅游业驱动的经济扩张以及大体上缺乏协调的开发活动，导致周边农业和乡村景观发生显著变化。本研究开发了一个基于地理信息系统（GIS）和遥感的空间分析框架，以系统性地识别处于城市蔓延压力下的乡村地区。该方法将城市扩张的方向和强度与现有乡村土地利用模式相结合，考察其空间相互作用。利用GIS环境中的多时相卫星影像，分析了城市增长的空间-时间动态，并划定了对城市侵占高度敏感的乡村区域。结果表明，城市蔓延的影响已超出既有建成区，日益集中于尚未城市化但对规划至关重要的过渡性乡村地带。所识别的空间格局为早期预警框架提供了基础，以支持农业用地保护和预防性土地利用政策的制定。尽管在安塔利亚进行了测试，该框架可推广至经历类似城市化动态的其他地区。

title: How much do mandatory minimums matter?
title_zh: 强制性最低刑罚有多重要？
title_primary: 强制性最低刑罚有多重要？
title_secondary: How much do mandatory minimums matter?
authors: Spencer Cooper
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mandatory minimum (MM) sentencing is frequently identified as a driver of long sentences among federal drug offenders, but estimating its causal impact is complicated by prosecutorial discretion in charging. First, I show evidence of selective manipulation of MM eligibility, with prosecutors disproportionately choosing minority defendants for eligibility relative to comparable white defendants. This selection behavior creates bias in naive estimates of MM effects on sentence length. To recover the causal impact of MM eligibility, I use a regression discontinuity design with extrapolation that disentangles statutory effects from prosecutorial selection. I find that eligibility increases sentence length by approximately 10 months (14 percent) uniformly across case types, with no discernible heterogeneity across race. Together, these results indicate that racial disparities in MM sentencing arise primarily from prosecutorial charging decisions rather than from features of the statute itself.
abstract_zh: 强制性最低刑期（MM）量刑常被视为联邦毒品犯罪者长期监禁的一个驱动因素，但评估其因果影响因检察官在指控中的自由裁量权而变得复杂。首先，我展示了MM资格选择性操纵的证据，检察官相对于类似的白人被告，不成比例地选择少数族裔被告符合资格。这种选择行为在朴素估计MM对刑期长度的影响时造成了偏差。为恢复MM资格的因果效应，我采用带有外推的回归断点设计，以区分法定效应与检察官选择效应。我发现，资格使刑期平均增加约10个月（14%），且在不同案件类型中一致，种族间未观察到明显异质性。综合来看，这些结果表明，MM量刑中的种族差异主要源于检察官的指控决定，而非法规本身的特点。

title: Macro Theory with Measured Expectations
title_zh: 基于预期测量的宏观理论
title_primary: 基于预期测量的宏观理论
title_secondary: Macro Theory with Measured Expectations
authors: Ralph Luetticke, Christopher Roth, Mirko Wiederholt, Johannes Wohlfart
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The Lucas critique holds that policy evaluations based on historical correlations can fail because policy changes alter expectation formation. We develop a new approach to monetary policy evaluation that addresses this concern: we elicit expectations under alternative policy scenarios from household surveys and feed these measured expectations into a heterogeneous agent model. The surveys reveal that the response of income and inflation expectations to interest rate changes is state-dependent. Incorporating these expectation differences into the model yields estimates of the effects of policy on aggregate consumption that are statedependent, varying with economic conditions at the time of the policy change.
abstract_zh: 卢卡斯批判认为，基于历史相关性进行的政策评估可能失效，因为政策变化会改变预期形成机制。我们开发了一种新的货币政策评估方法以应对这一关切：通过家庭调查引出不同政策情景下的预期，并将这些测得的预期输入到异质性主体模型中。调查结果显示，收入与通胀预期对利率变动的反应具有状态依赖性。将这些预期差异纳入模型后，我们得到的政策对总消费影响的估计值也具有状态依赖性，随政策实施时的经济状况而变化。

title: Leveraging Collective Advice-Taking Behavior to Infer Accuracy and Improve the Wisdom of Crowds
title_zh: 利用集体征求意见行为推断准确性并提升群体智慧
title_primary: 利用集体征求意见行为推断准确性并提升群体智慧
title_secondary: Leveraging Collective Advice-Taking Behavior to Infer Accuracy and Improve the Wisdom of Crowds
authors: Yunhao Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Wisdom of crowds estimates can be compromised when some agents’ predictions are systematically biased. A natural remedy is to aggregate predictions from a subset of more accurate agents rather than the entire crowd. I propose cluster weight on advice (CWOA), a novel “two-shot” algorithm to identify a more accurate subgroup in a single-prediction-problem context. CWOA first applies kernel density estimation to identify clusters of similar initial predictions. If multiple clusters emerge—indicating potential heterogeneity in agents’ information—the algorithm proceeds to present a piece of numerical advice (e.g., the group mean) and elicit updated predictions. This enables the calculation of the weight on advice (WOA)—the scaled magnitude of each agent’s belief revision. CWOA then averages the updated predictions within the cluster with the lowest mean WOA. A behavioral model and simulations explain both why and when cluster-level WOA signals accuracy. Better-informed agents—having already incorporated higher-quality information—perceive less corrective value in the advice and therefore, exhibit lower WOA. CWOA does not require agents to know the true biases or the composition of the crowd; a modest relative advantage in perceived estimation bias by better-informed agents may be sufficient, even under misperceptions of variance, advice quality, and psychological biases in advice taking. Empirically, I first test and confirm the model’s key insight in a controlled experimental setting. I then validate CWOA’s performance across multiple preregistered and archival data sets, including a study in which numerical advice comes from artificial intelligence. CWOA consistently outperforms benchmarks, including the state-of-the-art metaprediction-based methods. This paper was accepted by Jack Soll, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499 .
abstract_zh: 群体智慧估计可能因部分代理的预测存在系统性偏差而受损。一种自然的补救措施是聚合来自更准确代理子集的预测，而非整个群体。本文提出了一种新颖的“两阶段”算法——聚类建议权重法（CWOA），用于在单次预测问题情境中识别更准确的子群体。CWOA首先应用核密度估计来识别相似初始预测的聚类。若出现多个聚类——表明代理信息可能存在异质性——算法随后提供一条数值建议（如群体均值）并征询更新后的预测。这使计算建议权重（WOA）成为可能，即每位代理信念修正的缩放幅度。CWOA随后在平均WOA最低的聚类内对更新后的预测进行平均。行为模型与模拟解释了聚类级WOA为何以及何时能指示准确性。信息更充分的代理——因已纳入更高质量信息——感知到建议的修正价值较低，因此表现出较低的WOA。CWOA不要求代理知晓真实偏差或群体构成；信息更充分的代理在感知估计偏差上具备适度相对优势可能就足够，即使在方差、建议质量及建议采纳中的心理偏差存在误判的情况下亦然。实证方面，我首先在受控实验环境中检验并确认了模型的关键洞见。随后，我在多个预注册及档案数据集中验证了CWOA的表现，包括一项数值建议来自人工智能的研究。CWOA始终优于基准方法，包括基于元预测的最新方法。本文由Jack Soll在行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499获取。

title: Spatial spillovers and inequality in forest carbon emissions: Implications for land-use policy in Ethiopia
title_zh: 森林碳排放的空间溢出与不平等：对埃塞俄比亚土地利用政策的启示
title_primary: 森林碳排放的空间溢出与不平等：对埃塞俄比亚土地利用政策的启示
title_secondary: Spatial spillovers and inequality in forest carbon emissions: Implications for land-use policy in Ethiopia
authors: Gemedo Furo, Zhiwen Gong, Amenu Leta Duguma, Gezahegne Seyoum
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Forest carbon gross emissions from deforestation and degradation arise from interconnected socio-economic and ecological processes, including demographic pressure, urban expansion, and land-use transformation. In Ethiopia, these drivers exhibit strong spatial interdependence and temporal persistence, generating heterogeneous emission patterns that conventional econometric approaches may not sufficiently capture, especially the dynamic spatial characteristics of forest carbon emissions. This study examines the drivers of forest carbon gross emissions (FCGE) across time, space, and emission intensities using an integrated spatiotemporal framework that combines dynamic panel GMM estimation with spatial econometric models and the dynamic spatial Durbin model (DSDM)—alongside quantile regression analysis. Dynamic panel results show that population growth significantly increases FCGE, while the significant lagged FCGE term indicates strong persistence in forest carbon emissions over time. DSDM estimates indicate significant temporal persistence and spatial spillover effects, confirming that FCGE are driven by processes that are simultaneously dynamic and spatial, with stronger influences arising from boundary adjacency than from road network connectivity and distance decay. A 10% relative increase in urbanization is associated with an approximate 32% rise in emissions. Quantile regression results indicate strong asymmetries, with demographic, market, and land-use pressures exerting larger effects in high-emission regions. Overall, the findings underscore the need for coordinated, region-specific policies to mitigate FCGE, including early interventions to prevent persistent forest disturbances, targeted protection of vulnerable forest frontiers, stronger regulation of urban expansion, and locally tailored forest restoration strategies. The study provides robust, systems-based evidence to enhance REDD + implementation and climate-resilient environmental governance in Ethiopia and beyond.
abstract_zh: 毁林和森林退化导致的森林碳总排放量，源于社会经济与生态过程的相互交织，包括人口压力、城市扩张和土地利用转型。在埃塞俄比亚，这些驱动因素表现出强烈的空间相互依赖性和时间持续性，产生了异质性的排放模式，而传统计量经济学方法可能无法充分捕捉这些特征，尤其是森林碳排放的动态空间特性。本研究采用一个整合的时空框架，结合动态面板GMM估计、空间计量模型、动态空间杜宾模型（DSDM）以及分位数回归分析，考察森林碳总排放量（FCGE）在时间、空间和排放强度上的驱动因素。动态面板结果显示，人口增长显著增加FCGE，而显著的滞后FCGE项表明森林碳排放随时间具有强烈的持续性。DSDM估计显示显著的时间持续性和空间溢出效应，证实FCGE由同时具有动态性和空间性的过程驱动，且边界邻近性比道路网络连通性和距离衰减产生更强的影响。城市化相对增长10%与排放量约32%的上升相关。分位数回归结果显示显著的不对称性，人口、市场和土地利用压力在高排放地区产生更大的影响。总体而言，研究结果强调了需要协调一致、针对特定区域的政策来减缓FCGE，包括早期干预以防止持续的森林干扰、对脆弱森林前沿进行有针对性的保护、加强对城市扩张的监管，以及因地制宜的森林恢复策略。本研究提供了基于系统的稳健证据，以增强埃塞俄比亚及其他地区的REDD+实施和气候适应性环境治理。

title: Can Small Businesses Survive Chapter 11?
title_zh: 小企业能否在第十一章破产保护中生存？
title_primary: 小企业能否在第十一章破产保护中生存？
title_secondary: Can Small Businesses Survive Chapter 11?
authors: EDITH HOTCHKISS, BENJAMIN IVERSON, XIANG ZHENG
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A majority of small U.S. businesses attempting to reorganize in bankruptcy fail to do so. Subchapter V of Chapter 11 (SubV) streamlines bankruptcy for small firms by reducing bankruptcy costs and negotiation frictions, and enables entrepreneurs to retain ownership. We show that many businesses reorganize under SubV that otherwise would liquidate. Creditor recoveries and postbankruptcy survival rates are at least as high in SubV as in traditional Chapter 11s. Our results show the increase in reorganizations is not associated with continuation of unviable firms, and that creditors are not harmed by a shift in bargaining power toward small business owners.
abstract_zh: 美国大多数试图通过破产重组的小型企业未能成功。第11章第V分章（SubV）通过降低破产成本和谈判摩擦，为小企业简化了破产程序，并使企业家能够保留所有权。我们表明，许多原本会清算的企业在SubV下得以重组。债权人的回收率和破产后生存率在SubV中至少与传统第11章一样高。我们的结果显示，重组增加与不可持续企业的延续无关，且债权人并未因谈判权力向小企业主转移而受损。

title: Information Choice: Cost over Content
title_zh: 信息选择：成本重于内容
title_primary: 信息选择：成本重于内容
title_secondary: Information Choice: Cost over Content
authors: Kristóf Madarász, Marek Pycia
official: 官方在线 2023-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When supplying information, agents choose between options that differ both in their contents and in their costs. We establish a “cost-over-content” theorem for a large class of dynamic trading environments where buyers choose from arbitrary sets of processes (experiments) that reveal information to the seller. When all experiments are equally costly, choosing any given experiment is a perfect equilibrium. However, when experiments differ in costs, there is a unique equilibrium: all buyers choose the cheapest experiment, regardless of the information it pro- vides. We explore implications for market performance, privacy, data sale, and defaults in market regulation.
abstract_zh: 在提供信息时，代理人会在内容与成本均有所不同的选项间做出选择。我们针对一类广泛的动态交易环境确立了“成本优先于内容”定理，其中买方从任意一组向卖方揭示信息的过程（实验）集合中进行选择。当所有实验成本相同时，选择任一给定实验均构成完美均衡。然而，当实验成本存在差异时，存在唯一均衡：所有买方均选择成本最低的实验，无论其提供的信息内容如何。我们探讨了这一结论对市场表现、隐私、数据销售以及市场监管中默认规则的影响。

title: Assortment Optimization for the Multinomial Logit Model with Repeated Customer Interactions
title_zh: 重复顾客互动下多项Logit模型的分类优化

abstract: This paper presents the multinomial logit model with repeated customer interactions. In each period, the same customer selects a product from the recommended assortment or opts out. From the seller’s perspective, the choice probability in the current period is updated based on the purchase history of the customer. We derive this conditional choice probability and study the adaptive assortment recommendation strategy. Although the problem is generally intractable, we discover the structures of the optimal assortment when the customer interacts with the seller for two periods and the available products to recommend are identical in the two periods. For a general number of periods, we find that the optimal fixed assortments that are not adapted to the purchase history can achieve 50% of the optimal expected revenue, and the approximation ratio increases to 68.47% when the available products across periods are disjoint. Using real-world data sets, we demonstrate that the model with repeated customer interactions can better predict the purchase behavior and generate higher revenues. abstract_zh: 本文提出了考虑顾客重复交互的多项Logit模型。在每个周期内，同一顾客从推荐的商品集合中选择一件商品或选择退出。从卖方的角度来看，当前周期的选择概率会根据顾客的购买历史进行更新。我们推导了这一条件选择概率，并研究了自适应推荐策略。尽管该问题通常难以处理，但当顾客与卖方互动两个周期且两个周期内可供推荐的商品相同时，我们发现了最优商品集合的结构。对于一般周期数，我们发现不随购买历史调整的最优固定商品集合能够达到最优期望收入的50%，而当各周期可供商品不重叠时，近似比率提高至68.47%。利用真实世界的数据集，我们证明了考虑顾客重复交互的模型能更好地预测购买行为并产生更高的收入。本文由Chung Piaw Teo在优化领域接受。资助：作者感谢美团提供的资金支持。C. title: The Geography of Innovative Firms
title_zh: 创新企业的地理分布
title_primary: 创新企业的地理分布
title_secondary: The Geography of Innovative Firms
authors: Craig A. Chikis, Benny Kleinman, Marta Prato
official: 官方在线 2025-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Most U.S. innovation output originates from firms that operate R&D facilities across multiple local markets. We study how this geographic structure influences aggregate innovation and growth, and whether it is socially optimal. First, we develop an endogenous growth model featuring multi-market innovative firms that generate knowledge spillovers to geographically proximate firms. In equilibrium, firms may operate in too few or too many local markets, depending on how sensitive the local spillovers they generate are to their local size. Second, to quantify these effects, we link the model to data on firms’ R&D locations, patents, and citation networks. Using an event-study design, we show that firms’ spatial expansion increases spillovers to other firms and estimate how these spillovers depend on a firm’s local footprint. Our estimates imply that U.S. innovative firms operate in too few markets relative to the social optimum. Third, using quantitative counterfactuals, we find that policies promoting broader spatial scope yield larger welfare gains than standard R&D subsidies. Moreover, unlike R&D subsidies, such policies can also reduce regional inequality.
abstract_zh: 美国多数创新产出源自于在多个地方市场运营研发设施的企业。我们研究这一地理结构如何影响总体创新与增长，以及其是否达到社会最优状态。首先，我们构建了一个内生增长模型，其中包含多市场创新型企业，这些企业对地理邻近的企业产生知识溢出效应。在均衡状态下，企业可能运营于过少或过多的本地市场，这取决于它们所产生的本地溢出对其本地规模的敏感程度。其次，为量化这些效应，我们将模型与企业的研发地点、专利及引文网络数据相连接。利用事件研究设计，我们展示了企业的空间扩张增加了对其他企业的溢出效应，并估计了这些溢出如何依赖于企业的本地足迹。我们的估计表明，相对于社会最优状态，美国创新型企业运营的市场数量过少。第三，通过定量反事实分析，我们发现促进更广泛空间范围的政策比标准研发补贴能带来更大的福利收益。此外，与研发补贴不同，这类政策还能减少区域不平等。

title: Framing of ultra-processed foods in UK news media (2022–2023) and associations with quoted actors’ interests: a mixed-methods study

authors: Jennie C Parnham, Kiara Chang, Michael Essman, Deb Smith, Mike P Etkind 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Increasing attention on “ultra-processed” foods (UPFs) and their health effects has sparked policy debate. News media influences public perceptions yet understanding of UPF framing and industry influence remains limited. This study analysed UPF framing in UK news media and trade press, exploring interests of quoted individuals and organisations. We systematically searched UK media for UPF articles in 2022–23, identifying 188 articles for mixed-methods content analysis. Articles were examined for their position towards classifying food by processing-level (accepted/contested/mixed). Framing Theory guided identification of UPF frames describing problem definitions, causes, and solutions. Actors’ interests were classified using academic journal guidelines. Half the articles (52%) accepted the UPF concept, 19% contested it, and 29% were mixed. Five frames were identified. The ‘Social Justice’, ‘Lifestyle Drift’, and ‘Science Report’ frames accepted the UPF concept, with the ‘Social Justice’ frame positioning UPF consumption as a structural public health problem requiring policy action such as taxes or front-of-package labelling. The ‘UPF Critique’ and ‘Market Justice’ frames contested the scientific basis of the UPF concept, proposing nutrient-based approaches instead. Among 116 named actors, 33% had UPF industry interests, with academics comprising 45% and industry spokespeople 11%. Actors with UPF industry interests were more commonly cited in contesting frames (e.g. ‘Market Justice’: 73%) than accepting frames (e.g. ‘Social Justice’: 10%). These findings highlight that industry influence on UPF media discourse is often obscured behind academic voices. Greater transparency around actor interests is urgently needed to ensure emerging UPF policies are shaped by independent evidence.
abstract_zh: 关于“超加工食品”（UPFs）及其健康影响的关注日益增加，引发了政策辩论。新闻媒体影响公众认知，但对UPF框架构建及行业影响力的理解仍然有限。本研究分析了英国新闻媒体和行业出版物中UPF的框架构建，探讨了被引用的个人和组织的利益关系。我们系统检索了2022-23年间英国媒体中关于UPF的文章，识别出188篇文章进行混合方法内容分析。文章根据其对按加工水平分类食品的立场（接受/质疑/混合）进行审查。框架理论指导了描述问题定义、原因和解决方案的UPF框架识别。行动者的利益根据学术期刊指南进行分类。半数文章（52%）接受UPF概念，19%质疑，29%持混合态度。识别出五种框架。“社会正义”、“生活方式漂移”和“科学报告”框架接受UPF概念，其中“社会正义”框架将UPF消费定位为结构性公共卫生问题，需要税收或前包装标签等政策行动。“UPF批判”和“市场正义”框架质疑UPF概念的科学基础，提出基于营养的方法作为替代。在116名具名行动者中，33%具有UPF行业利益，学者占45%，行业发言人占11%。具有UPF行业利益的行动者更常见于质疑框架（如“市场正义”：73%）而非接受框架（如“社会正义”：10%）。这些发现强调，行业对UPF媒体话语的影响常常隐藏在学术声音背后。迫切需要提高行动者利益的透明度，以确保新兴的UPF政策由独立证据塑造。

abstract: Using employer-employee Italian data over the period 1998-2018 we analyze the impact of the largest regularization of undocumented immigrant workers in Italy on wage, employment and mobility outcomes of natives. Our empirical strategy takes advantage of the 2002 Bossi-Fini law that unexpectedly regularized 634,000 undocumented non-EU immigrants, with variation across firms and provinces that was not correlated with previous economic performance. We find that the policy had a small effect on the average wage of native workers and positive effects on their employment at the local labor market level. Additionally, native co-workers in firms more affected by the policy were more likely to change employers in the post-policy period. Such higher mobility resulted in a heterogeneous wage effect across switchers: workers that managed to transition towards better firms experienced wage gains in the medium- and long-run, while other workers experienced wage losses. This implied an increase in wage dispersion for natives and some losers among Italian workers.
abstract_zh: 基于1998-2018年意大利雇主-雇员匹配数据，本文分析了意大利最大规模非法移民合法化政策对本土劳动者工资、就业及流动性的影响。实证策略利用2002年《博西-菲尼法》意外合法化63.4万非欧盟非法移民这一准自然实验，通过企业与省份层面的变异识别政策效应，且该变异与地区前期经济表现无关。研究发现：该政策对本土劳动者平均工资影响较小，但在地方劳动力市场层面产生了正向就业效应；此外，受政策冲击较大的企业中，本土同事在政策实施后更可能更换雇主。这种高流动性导致流动者面临异质性工资效应：成功转向优质企业的劳动者在中长期获得工资增长，而其他流动者则遭受工资损失。这最终加剧了本土劳动者的工资离散度，并导致部分意大利劳动者成为政策受损方。

abstract: We develop and empirically support a theory showing that when firms patent enhancements to incumbent, non-disruptive technologies, they can cooperate more easily on these technologies, increasing their profitability. The downside of cooperating on non-disruptive technologies is that the investment in and commitment to disruptive technologies decline. To improve their commitment to disruptive technologies, some firms rely more on trade secrecy. We provide empirical support for these predictions. We document that after a patent reform that made information about patent applications widely accessible, firms cooperate more and charge higher markups. Furthermore, the nature of patented innovation has changed, with the proportion of non-disruptive patents increasing substantially. Finally, while some firms start patenting more, others patent less and rely more on trade secrecy, with the response depending on the attractiveness of firms' innovation prospects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建并实证支持了一个理论，表明当企业为现有非颠覆性技术的改进申请专利时，它们在这些技术上更容易合作，从而提高盈利能力。然而，合作于非颠覆性技术的弊端在于，对颠覆性技术的投资和承诺会减少。为了增强对颠覆性技术的承诺，一些企业更加依赖商业秘密保护。我们为这些预测提供了实证支持。我们记录到，在专利改革使得专利申请信息广泛可获取之后，企业合作增多并收取更高的加成率。此外，专利创新的性质发生了变化，非颠覆性专利的比例大幅增加。最后，虽然一些企业开始增加专利申请，但另一些企业则减少专利申请并更多依赖商业秘密，其反应取决于企业创新前景的吸引力。

abstract: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了执业护士与医生这两类职业的生产力差异。二者虽承担重叠性工作任务，但背景、培训经历及薪酬水平存在显著差异。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科患者随机分配至执业护士或医生的准实验变异，我们发现：平均而言，执业护士消耗更多医疗资源，且30天内可预防住院率高于医生。然而，执业护士与医生的绩效差异随病例复杂程度和严重程度而变化。值得注意的是，两类职业内部的生产力差异更为显著，导致二者生产力分布存在大量重叠——在38%的随机配对中，执业护士的表现优于医生。

abstract: This paper studies the impacts of administrative burdens across multiple welfare programs and application stages via an increasingly widespread phenomenon: the automation of caseworker assistance. Leveraging a natural experiment phased in across Indiana’s counties and administrative records for 3 million recipients, we find that SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid enrollments fell by 15%, 24%, and 4% after automation. Heterogeneous declines are attributable to cross-program differences in recertification costs. Needier individuals exited while less needy individuals were screened out at entry, potentially reconciling some conflicting results in the literature and best understood through a dynamic selection model of certification and recertification.
abstract_zh: 本文通过日益普遍的行政自动化现象，研究跨多个福利项目及申请阶段的行政负担影响。利用印第安纳州各县分阶段实施的自然实验及300万受助者的行政记录，我们发现自动化后，SNAP、TANF和Medicaid的注册人数分别下降了15%、24%和4%。异质性下降可归因于不同项目在重新认证成本上的差异。需求更迫切的个体退出，而需求较低的个体在进入阶段被筛选排除，这一发现可能调和了文献中部分相互矛盾的结果，并通过认证与重新认证的动态选择模型得以最佳解释。

abstract: We develop a simple quantitative New Keynesian model aimed at analyzing how the reaction of monetary policy contributed to the recent rise and fall in inflation. The model includes several shocks but features oil price shocks for two reasons: (i) energy prices have been among the central factors in discussions about the surge; (ii) we can use identified oil shocks along with monetary shocks to estimate and discipline the model. We then employ the estimated framework to recover shocks without targeting inflation. Both the oil shocks and the shocks to policy accommodation played important roles in the inflation rise.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约的定量新凯恩斯模型，旨在分析货币政策反应如何助推近期通胀的涨落。该模型包含多种冲击，但特别引入油价冲击，原因有二：（i）能源价格一直是通胀飙升讨论中的核心因素；（ii）我们可利用已识别的石油冲击与货币冲击对模型进行估计和约束。随后，我们运用该估计框架在不以通胀为目标的情况下反推各类冲击。研究显示，石油冲击与政策宽松冲击均在通胀上升过程中发挥了重要作用。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The European Union promotes the provision of agri-environment-climate public goods (AECPGs) from agriculture and forestry through dedicated policies. Nevertheless, despite long-term efforts and earmarking of significant financial resources for voluntary agri-environmental schemes, the provision of AECPGs from Europe’s agro-ecosystems is continuing to decline. New governance instruments are urgently required to revert this process. Promising new approaches are seen in novel contract solutions promoting result-based payments, collective implementation, and value-chain-based approaches. However, a deeper understanding of the practical design of these novel schemes is needed to achieve acceptance and successful implementation. We systematically examine real-world examples of contract solutions and their design characteristics by analyzing a dataset of 44 case studies from 13 European countries. Data or information from these case studies was collected using a uniform protocol across countries, and a qualitative content analysis was conducted. Our findings show that result-based approaches differ in their design with regard to measuring environmental performance. Successful result-based approaches enable flexible management, include features for knowledge provision, and are often designed as hybrid solutions to enhance uptake, combining action- and result-based elements. Collective contract solutions are based on a common management agreement of the involved group members, but vary in their degree of formalization, often include a coordinator, and foster meetings and exchanges. Value chain-based solutions differ in terms of the relationship between the production of private goods and the provision of AECPGs, their incentive system, value chain characteristics, and marketing, and often comprise an element of cooperation, also representing a hybrid approach. The findings of this research can help shape the design of such alternative approaches and provide inspiration for promoting the voluntary delivery of AECPGs under the Common Agriculture Policy (CAP) and beyond. abstract_zh: 欧盟通过专项政策推动农业与林业提供农业-环境-气候公共产品（AECPGs）。然而，尽管长期投入大量财政资源用于自愿性农业环境计划，欧洲农业生态系统提供的AECPGs仍在持续减少。亟需新的治理工具来扭转这一趋势。新型合同方案展现出前景，包括推广基于结果的支付、集体实施以及基于价值链的方法。但为获得认可并成功实施，需深入理解这些新型方案的实际设计。我们通过分析来自13个欧洲国家的44个案例数据集，系统考察了合同方案的真实案例及其设计特征。这些案例的数据或信息采用跨国统一协议收集，并进行了定性内容分析。研究结果表明：基于结果的方法在环境绩效衡量设计上存在差异；成功的基于结果方法允许灵活管理，包含知识供给特征，且常设计为结合行动与结果要素的混合方案以提升采纳率。集体合同方案基于参与群体成员的共同管理协议，但正式化程度各异，通常设有协调人，并促进会议与交流。基于价值链的方案在私人物品生产与AECPGs供给的关系、激励机制、价值链特征及营销方式上存在差异，且常包含合作要素，同样体现混合模式。本研究结果有助于塑造此类替代方案的设计，并为在共同农业政策（CAP）及其他框架下促进AECPGs自愿供给提供启示。

abstract: We extend the heteroskedasticity IV estimator of Rigobon and Sack (2004) to multiple monetary policy shocks by imposing recursive zero restrictions on the impact matrix. Unlike high-frequency identification, the approach requires neither intraday tick data nor precise announcement timestamps, making it applicable to countries and historical periods where such data are unavailable. Applied to US FOMC announcements, we find causal effects similar to those of high-frequency identification. The heteroskedasticity-based instrument passes weak-instrument tests for the target shock, whereas results are mixed for high-frequency surprises. For the path shock, we obtain strong instruments for the majority of specifications and the underlying shock series is highly correlated with the high-frequency counterpart.

abstract: We study fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, which have expanded rapidly and now manage over $300 billion in assets. These funds perform liquidity transformation by holding far more illiquid loans than traditional loan mutual funds while allowing investors to redeem at NAV through quarterly repurchase offers, typically capped at 5% of shares outstanding. We show that cash buffers and contractual loan repayments are insufficient to fund repeated 5% quarterly redemptions; inflows decline precisely when outflows rise; and net outflows are met with sales of illiquid loans, external borrowing, and delayed payments through repurchases payable. As a result, strategic complementarity arises, because redemptions impose liquidation and leverage costs on the remaining investors. We show that loan liquidation, leverage increase, and NAV inflation play an important role in amplifying the current episodes of run-like redemptions. Overall, our evidence suggests that quarterly gates and redemption caps do not eliminate run-like fragility in semi-liquid private credit funds, raising cautions about expanding retail access to private credit markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了半流动性私募信贷基金的脆弱性。这类基金近年来迅速扩张，目前管理资产规模已超过3000亿美元。这些基金通过持有远多于传统贷款共同基金的流动性较差的贷款来实现流动性转换，同时允许投资者通过季度回购要约（通常上限为流通份额的5%）按资产净值赎回。我们证明，现金缓冲和合同约定的贷款偿还不足以应对持续5%的季度赎回；资金流入恰恰在流出上升时减少；净流出通过出售流动性较差的贷款、外部借款以及通过应付回购延迟支付来应对。因此，战略互补性出现，因为赎回对剩余投资者施加了清算和杠杆成本。我们表明，贷款清算、杠杆增加和资产净值膨胀在当前类似挤兑的赎回事件放大中发挥了重要作用。总体而言，我们的证据表明，季度赎回门槛和赎回上限并未消除半流动性私募信贷基金中类似挤兑的脆弱性，这为扩大零售投资者进入私募信贷市场敲响了警钟。

title: Governance and Management of Autonomous Organizations
title_zh: 自治组织的治理与管理
title_primary: 自治组织的治理与管理
title_secondary: Governance and Management of Autonomous Organizations
authors: Daniel Ferreira, Jin Li
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: An organization is autonomous if it has the right or power of self-government. Self-government implies that autonomous organizations cannot rely on outside parties for contract enforcement; all contracts must be relational or self-executing. We present a model in which an autonomous organization commits to a governance structure that allocates managerial power to some members. We show that the organization faces a trilemma: the goals of autonomy, decentralization, and efficiency conflict with one another. Thus, the optimal governance structure of an autonomous organization is centralized. Centralization implies inequality in power and payoffs among members of autonomous organizations.
abstract_zh: 如果一个组织拥有自治权或自我治理的能力，则该组织具有自主性。自我治理意味着自主组织不能依赖外部主体执行契约；所有契约必须是关系型或自我执行的。我们构建了一个模型，其中自主组织承诺采用一种将管理权力分配给部分成员的治理结构。研究表明，该组织面临一个三难困境：自主性、去中心化与效率这三个目标相互冲突。因此，自主组织的最优治理结构是集权化的。集权化意味着自主组织成员之间在权力和收益分配上存在不平等。

title: From abandonment to sustainable use: Prioritizing land consolidation with ALS-derived vegetation metrics in Małopolskie Voivodeship, southern Poland
title_zh: 从废弃到可持续利用：基于ALS植被指标的波兰南部小波兰省土地整理优先级排序
title_primary: 从废弃到可持续利用：基于ALS植被指标的波兰南部小波兰省土地整理优先级排序
title_secondary: From abandonment to sustainable use: Prioritizing land consolidation with ALS-derived vegetation metrics in Małopolskie Voivodeship, southern Poland
authors: Ela Ertunç, Piotr Bożek, Jarosław Janus
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In many parts of Europe, particularly in countries such as Spain, Poland, Italy, Portugal, and Romania, farmland abandonment is widespread as a result of changing land use and socioeconomic circumstances. A balanced strategy is needed to identify which abandoned lands should be restored for agricultural production and which should remain unused. Although earlier research has shown that land consolidation can lower the likelihood of abandonment, no studies have used local-scale data and high-resolution spatial datasets to determine whether abandoned land can be returned to production. In this study, a new approach is proposed for the regeneration of abandoned agricultural lands through land consolidation. In order to find abandoned agricultural parcels that could be restored by land consolidation, this study presents a novel methodology that combines cadastral databases with data from Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS). The study was conducted in Małopolskie Voivodeship, southern Poland, with a detailed case study in Olkusz Poviat, where agricultural land abandonment is relatively high. A total of 79 villages with a combined area of 620 km² were selected as the study area. The villages are prioritized for land consolidation projects based on their potential, with a unique reward-penalty function applied based on vegetation height, prioritizing areas with the highest likelihood of reducing or reversing land abandonment. The proposed approach identifies which abandoned lands can be returned to production as part of land consolidation efforts. This study presents a new, data-driven approach to rural land management that enables targeted policy interventions, allowing planners to prioritize areas at high risk of abandonment, make informed decisions, and develop land consolidation projects that maximize sustainable land use and agricultural productivity.
abstract_zh: 在欧洲许多地区，尤其是在西班牙、波兰、意大利、葡萄牙和罗马尼亚等国家，由于土地利用变化和社会经济状况的变迁，农田弃耕现象普遍存在。需要采取一种平衡策略，以确定哪些弃耕地应恢复用于农业生产，哪些应保持闲置状态。尽管早期研究表明，土地整理可以降低弃耕的可能性，但尚无研究利用地方尺度数据和高分辨率空间数据集来确定弃耕地是否能够恢复生产。本研究提出了一种通过土地整理实现弃耕地再生的新方法。为了找到可通过土地整理恢复的弃耕农业地块，本研究提出了一种新颖的方法论，将地籍数据库与机载激光扫描（ALS）数据相结合。研究在波兰南部的马沃波尔斯卡省进行，并在奥库什县进行了详细的案例研究，该地区农业弃耕现象相对严重。共选取了79个村庄，总面积620平方公里作为研究区域。根据潜力对这些村庄进行土地整理项目的优先级排序，并基于植被高度应用独特的奖惩函数，优先考虑最有可能减少或逆转弃耕的区域。所提出的方法能够识别哪些弃耕地可以作为土地整理工作的一部分恢复生产。本研究提出了一种新的、数据驱动的农村土地管理方法，能够实现有针对性的政策干预，使规划者能够优先考虑弃耕高风险区域，做出明智决策，并制定最大化可持续土地利用和农业生产力的土地整理项目。

title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
title_zh: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究
title_primary: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究
title_secondary: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
authors: Olivier Armantier, Charles Holt
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)
abstract_zh: 摘要 美联储的一项核心职责是通过贴现窗口（DW）作为最后贷款人，以维护金融稳定。然而，由于使用贴现窗口存在污名化问题，其有效性受到制约。本文通过理论与实验研究，探讨如何消除此类污名。我们发现，行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口困难重重，但增设新的后备融资工具有助于缓解污名化。这些结论与美联储的实际经验相符。（JEL E58, G01, C92）

title: Where Are Pakistan’s Out-of-School Children ? Mapping Accessibility of Schooling Using Satellite Data and Machine Learning Methods with an Application to the 2022 Floods
title_zh: 巴基斯坦失学儿童在哪里？利用卫星数据和机器学习方法绘制学校可及性地图——以2022年洪水为例
title_primary: 巴基斯坦失学儿童在哪里？利用卫星数据和机器学习方法绘制学校可及性地图——以2022年洪水为例
title_secondary: Where Are Pakistan’s Out-of-School Children ? Mapping Accessibility of Schooling Using Satellite Data and Machine Learning Methods with an Application to the 2022 Floods
authors: Saif, Umar, Hasan, Amer, Tahir, Ayesha, Geven, Koen Martijn, Ali, Mohsen 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: According to administrative data, as many as 25 million children between the ages of 5 and 16 are out-of-school in Pakistan. However, little is known about where these children are in relation to available public and private schooling options. This paper brings together novel data from satellite imagery, the population census, government school censuses of public schools, and publicly available location data on private schools to understand the out-of-school phenomenon at the community level. The paper uses satellite imagery analysis and machine learning methods to present estimates of the accessibility of schools and to describe the whitespace between schools. The paper relies on administrative data from more than 137, 000 public schools and documents the existence of more than 72, 700 private schools using publicly available location data. The approach suggests that 21.7 million children (49 percent of the total) are enrolled in private schools, higher than previously reported official estimates. The paper also presents detailed data on how the out-of-school population, accessibility, and whitespace are distributed geo-spatially across Pakistan. As an application of the strength of using satellite imagery, it analyzes the effect of a major flood event in 2022 on accessibility, whitespace, and catchment areas. Doing so suggests that the 2022 floods affected the schooling of approximately 3.5 million children in Pakistan. Lastly, an in-person ground-truthing survey conducted about 18 months after the floods is used to corroborate the findings. Together, the data sets and methods presented in this paper have applications for both day-to-day monitoring of school infrastructure as well as pre- and post-disaster planning efforts in Pakistan and elsewhere.
abstract_zh: 根据行政数据，巴基斯坦有多达2500万5至16岁儿童失学。然而，关于这些儿童与现有公立及私立教育资源的空间分布关系，目前知之甚少。本文整合了卫星影像、人口普查、公立学校行政普查及私立学校公开位置数据等新型数据集，从社区层面解析失学现象。通过卫星影像分析与机器学习方法，本文估算了学校的可达性，并描述了学校之间的"空白区域"。研究基于超过13.7万所公立学校的行政数据，并利用公开位置数据确认了超过7.27万所私立学校的存在。分析表明，2170万儿童（占总数的49%）就读于私立学校，这一比例高于此前官方报告的估计值。本文还详细呈现了失学人口、可达性及空白区域在巴基斯坦地理空间上的分布情况。作为卫星影像应用优势的例证，本文分析了2022年特大洪水事件对学校可达性、空白区域及学区范围的影响，结果显示该洪水影响了巴基斯坦约350万儿童的学业。最后，通过洪水发生约18个月后开展的实地验证调查，进一步佐证了研究结论。本文提出的数据集与方法体系，不仅适用于巴基斯坦及其他地区学校基础设施的日常监测，也可服务于灾前预防与灾后重建规划工作。

title: The Role of Economic and Weather Conditions in Farmer Suicide in the United States
title_zh: 美国经济与天气条件对农民自杀的影响
title_primary: 美国经济与天气条件对农民自杀的影响
title_secondary: The Role of Economic and Weather Conditions in Farmer Suicide in the United States
authors: Qi Wu, Pierre Mérel, Richard J. Sexton
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Farmers commit suicide at high rates relative to the general population in the United States and elsewhere. Prior studies on farmer suicide have generally focused on socio‐demographic characteristics of individuals and on method of suicide, but few quantitative analyses have sought to understand the possible role of economic and climatic factors as determinants of suicide among farmers. This study addresses this void. We develop an economic model to show how poor economic outcomes or adverse weather conditions can reduce current‐period utility and diminish expectations of future utility through accumulation of debt and formation of expectations of future economic and climatic conditions, with suicide resulting in extreme cases. Our empirical analysis merges CDC nonpublic vital statistics, PRISM daily weather data, and USDA NASS crop and livestock price data into a county‐year panel to estimate the relationship between weather variables, economic factors, and farmer suicides. Results based upon a Poisson regression model show that long‐term, not transitory, poor economic conditions are associated with higher rates of farmer suicide. Extreme heat is also associated with increased farmer suicide, especially in counties most reliant upon animal agriculture. Precipitation appears to play little role in U.S. farmer suicide.
abstract_zh: 美国及其他地区的农民自杀率显著高于普通人群。此前关于农民自杀的研究多聚焦于个体社会人口学特征及自杀方式，但鲜有定量分析探讨经济和气候因素作为农民自杀决定因素的潜在作用。本研究填补了这一空白。我们构建了一个经济模型，论证了不良经济结果或恶劣天气如何通过债务累积及对未来经济和气候条件的预期形成，降低当期效用并削弱未来效用预期，极端情况下导致自杀。实证分析整合了美国疾病控制与预防中心非公开生命统计数据、PRISM逐日天气数据及美国农业部国家农业统计局作物与牲畜价格数据，构建县级年度面板数据，以估计气候变量、经济因素与农民自杀之间的关系。基于泊松回归模型的结果表明，长期（而非暂时性）经济状况恶化与农民自杀率上升相关。极端高温同样与农民自杀增加相关，尤其在畜牧业依赖度最高的县。降水量对美国农民自杀的影响似乎微乎其微。

title: Similar patterns, different processes: Persistence and change in path-dependent land systems
title_zh: 相似模式，不同过程：路径依赖土地系统中的持续与变迁
title_primary: 相似模式，不同过程：路径依赖土地系统中的持续与变迁
title_secondary: Similar patterns, different processes: Persistence and change in path-dependent land systems
authors: Lien Imbrechts, João C. Azevedo, Rebekka Dossche, Matthias Bürgi, Peter H. Verburg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Large-scale land use changes can lead to a fundamental reorganisation of the land and corresponding socioecological regime. These regime shifts are notably hard to detect, predict or model, often arising from unprecedented changes in technology, markets or policies. In a remote rural region in Portugal, we tracked the land use history in three parishes between 1899 and 2018, capturing multiple disruptive socioeconomic and political circumstances, to assess whether a regime shift was triggered. We used a causal historical approach that included the spatio-temporal mapping of LULC changes and a socioecological event timeline to track policy changes and other important events or circumstances. We used these, and other available (historic) literature, to contextualise local information provided in oral history interviews (OHI) that revealed land managers’ decision-making during the last 70 years. We found that during the Estado Novo dictatorship, productivism-based policies had a strong influence on the observed land use intensification, yet OHI revealed that the high level of self-sufficiency agriculture made alternative trajectories unlikely if not impossible. After the 1974 revolution, recalibration took place in the form of a rural exodus and associated land reorganisation, including tenure and production systems. Overall, semi-natural areas, which usually depend on grazing or pastoralism, strongly diminished, while natural and plantation forests expanded. Arable land areas remained relatively stable across the entire study period. Our study shows that land systems that have undergone disruptive changes in the past may continue to evolve discontinuously afterwards, without causing a socioecological regime shift or breaking path dependence.
abstract_zh: 大规模土地利用变化可能导致土地及其相应的社会生态体系发生根本性重组。这些体系转变往往难以察觉、预测或建模，通常源于技术、市场或政策的空前变化。在葡萄牙一个偏远的乡村地区，我们追踪了1899年至2018年间三个教区的土地利用历史，捕捉了多次破坏性的社会经济和政治环境，以评估是否触发了体系转变。我们采用了一种因果历史方法，包括土地利用/土地覆盖变化的时空制图和社会生态事件时间线，以追踪政策变化及其他重要事件或情况。我们利用这些资料及其他可用的（历史）文献，对口头历史访谈中提供的本地信息进行背景化处理，这些访谈揭示了土地管理者在过去70年间的决策过程。我们发现，在“新国家”独裁时期，基于生产主义的政策对观察到的土地利用集约化产生了强烈影响，但口头历史访谈显示，高度自给自足的农业使得替代路径即使不是不可能，也是极不可能实现的。1974年革命后，以农村人口外流及相应的土地重组（包括土地所有权和生产体系）形式进行了重新调整。总体而言，通常依赖放牧或畜牧业的半自然区域大幅减少，而自然林和人工林则有所扩展。在整个研究期间，耕地面积保持相对稳定。我们的研究表明，过去经历过破坏性变化的土地系统可能在此后继续以不连续的方式演变，而不会引发社会生态体系转变或打破路径依赖。

title: Extending the procedure of Engelberg et al. (2009) to surveys with unequal interval widths
title_zh: 将Engelberg等人(2009)的方法扩展到不等区间宽度的调查
title_primary: 将Engelberg等人(2009)的方法扩展到不等区间宽度的调查

abstract: The approach by Engelberg et al. (2009) to convert probabilistic survey responses into continuous probability distributions implicitly assumes that the question intervals are equally wide. Almost all recently established surveys have intervals of unequal width. Applying the standard approach to these surveys gives implausible and potentially misleading results. This note shows how the approach of Engelberg et al. (2009) can be adjusted to account for intervals of unequal width.
abstract_zh: Engelberg等人（2009年）将概率调查回答转换为连续概率分布的方法，隐含假设了问题区间宽度相等。然而，几乎所有近期建立的调查都采用了不等宽区间。将标准方法应用于这些调查，会产生不合理且可能具有误导性的结果。本文展示了如何调整Engelberg等人（2009年）的方法，以适应不等宽区间的情况。

title: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
title_zh: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说
title_primary: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说
title_secondary: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
authors: MICHAEL T. KILEY
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Activity shortfalls are more costly than strong activity. I consider optimal monetary policy under discretion with an asymmetric (shortfalls) loss function in a natural rate model. The optimal monetary policy exacerbates shortfalls, owing to the adjustment of expectations implied by the natural rate hypothesis, and leads to an inflationary bias. Mandating a central bank objective with greater symmetry lowers activity shortfalls and inflation bias. The model also implies that an optimal monetary policy does not accommodate fluctuations from aggregate demand shocks. The analysis implies that monetary accommodation of strong economic activity requires justifications other than asymmetric costs of shortfalls.
abstract_zh: 活动缺口比强劲活动代价更高。本文在自然率模型下，考虑具有非对称（缺口）损失函数的相机抉择最优货币政策。由于自然率假说所隐含的预期调整，最优货币政策会加剧活动缺口，并导致通胀偏差。设定更具对称性的央行目标可降低活动缺口与通胀偏差。该模型还表明，最优货币政策不会对总需求冲击引发的波动进行调节。分析表明，对强劲经济活动的货币调节需要以缺口非对称成本之外的理由作为依据。

title: Does Unfairness Hurt Women? The Effects of Losing Unfair Competitions
title_zh: 不公平会伤害女性吗？输掉不公平竞争的影响
title_primary: 不公平会伤害女性吗？输掉不公平竞争的影响
title_secondary: Does Unfairness Hurt Women? The Effects of Losing Unfair Competitions
authors: Stefano Piasenti, Marica Valente, Roel van Veldhuizen, Gregor Pfeifer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study gender differences in the response to losing competitions using an online experiment (N=2,086). We find that both genders reduce tournament entry rates in response to losses that are unequivocally meritocratic. However, when the winner is not necessarily determined by merit—a setting perceived as less fair than the meritocratic tournament—female losers are relatively more discouraged. These results suggest that women are more negatively affected by competitions perceived as unfair than men. Exploratory machine learning analysis indicates that risk preferences, age and sports participation in adolescence are associated with a reduced impact of losing competitions.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项在线实验（N=2,086）研究性别在应对竞争失败时的差异。研究发现，在明确基于能力的竞争中，男女两性均会因失败而降低参赛率。然而，当获胜者并非必然由能力决定——这种情境被认为不如能力型竞争公平——女性失败者相对更受挫。这些结果表明，相较于男性，女性对被认为不公平的竞争会产生更消极的反应。探索性机器学习分析显示，风险偏好、年龄及青少年时期参与体育运动与竞争失败影响的减弱相关。

title: Market Design in a Weather‐Dependent and Distributed Electricity System: Lessons From the 2025 NEM Review
title_zh: 天气依赖与分布式电力系统中的市场设计：2025年国家电力市场审查的启示
title_primary: 天气依赖与分布式电力系统中的市场设计：2025年国家电力市场审查的启示
title_secondary: Market Design in a Weather‐Dependent and Distributed Electricity System: Lessons From the 2025 NEM Review
authors: Tim Nelson
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-05-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) is undergoing a rapid transition to a weather‐dependent and increasingly distributed system. This article draws on the 2025 NEM Review to examine whether the core energy‐only market design remains fit for purpose. It argues that the principal challenge is not the operation of the spot market, but the weakening of linkages between short‐term dispatch, medium‐term risk management and long‐term investment. The growth of behind‐the‐meter resources has reduced system visibility, the shift to renewable generation has altered the nature of risk, and a structural mismatch between contracting horizons and asset lives has created a ‘tenor gap’. Policy responses should therefore focus on improving visibility, strengthening forward markets and introducing targeted mechanisms to support long‐term investment while preserving market signals.
abstract_zh: 澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）正快速向依赖天气且日益分散的系统转型。本文基于2025年NEM评估报告，探讨核心的纯电能市场设计是否仍适用。研究认为，主要挑战并非现货市场的运行，而是短期调度、中期风险管理与长期投资之间关联的弱化。表计后端资源的增长降低了系统可见性，可再生能源发电的转变改变了风险性质，而合约期限与资产寿命之间的结构性错配形成了"期限缺口"。因此，政策应对应聚焦于提升可见性、强化远期市场，并在保留市场信号的同时引入针对性机制以支持长期投资。

abstract: About one‐quarter of the global population, that is, approximately 1.8 billion people, with 90% in low‐ and middle‐income countries, face substantial weather‐related risks. This paper studies how weather shocks are associated with crop diversification and household food security in Nigeria, with a focus on gendered plot management. We merge historical climate data with the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study—Integrated Surveys on Agriculture (LSMS‐ISA) to construct rainfall anomaly (z‐score) and temperature extreme (Killing Degree Days, KDD) measures, household crop diversification, and household food security indicators. Using a Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) model, we find that both rainfall shocks and extreme temperatures are negatively associated with household dietary diversity, but the relationship is mixed for other food security outcomes. Crop diversification is positively associated with food security under high temperature exposure, but the relationship is mixed under rainfall anomalies. The gender composition of household plot managers does not show a statistically robust moderating role in the aggregate; however, gender differences emerge at certain thresholds of weather exposure. The results highlight the heterogeneity in the crop diversification—food security relationship across weather dimensions.
abstract_zh: 全球约四分之一人口（约18亿人）面临重大气候相关风险，其中90%生活在低收入和中等收入国家。本文以尼日利亚为研究对象，聚焦地块管理的性别差异，探讨天气冲击与作物多样化及家庭粮食安全之间的关联。我们将历史气候数据与世界银行生活标准测量研究——农业综合调查（LSMS-ISA）相结合，构建了降雨异常（z-score）和极端温度（致死度日，KDD）指标，以及家庭作物多样化和粮食安全指标。采用双向固定效应（TWFE）模型研究发现，降雨冲击和极端温度均与家庭膳食多样性呈负相关，但与其他粮食安全指标的关系则呈现混合特征。在高温暴露条件下，作物多样化与粮食安全呈正相关，但在降雨异常情境下两者关系复杂。从总体来看，家庭地块管理者的性别构成并未表现出统计上稳健的调节作用；然而，在特定天气暴露阈值下，性别差异开始显现。研究结果揭示了作物多样化与粮食安全关系在不同天气维度上的异质性。

abstract: ABSTRACT Understanding the relationship between plant capacity and performance among agricultural processors in developing economies remains essential for effective policy design. Exploiting exogenous international sugar price fluctuations between 2008/09 and 2016/17, this study employs a quasi‐experimental framework to examine how plant capacity influences profitability within China's sugar industry. Using detailed panel data for 99 sugar plants in Guangxi province, I find that plants with greater capacity realise significantly higher profit gains under the same price shock. Specifically, facing the same exogenous international sugar price increase of 500 yuan , a plant with daily production one standard deviation higher (4691 tonnes) experiences an additional increase of approximately 32 yuan in unit profit relative to a smaller plant. This scale‐driven profitability advantage primarily results from lower non‐raw material costs rather than improved selling prices or higher productivity. This study further identifies heterogeneity in capacity effects by plant ownership and location in major versus minor production regions, highlighting the nuanced role of economies of scale and local policy interventions. These findings contribute novel insights into how firm‐level characteristics mediate the effects of global market shocks, offering clear policy implications for optimising agricultural processing efficiency in resource‐dependent regions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 理解发展中经济体农产品加工企业产能与绩效之间的关系，对于有效政策设计至关重要。利用2008/09至2016/17年间外生国际糖价波动，本研究采用准实验框架，考察产能如何影响中国糖业盈利能力。基于广西省99家糖厂的详细面板数据，本研究发现，在相同价格冲击下，产能较大的糖厂实现了显著更高的利润增长。具体而言，面对相同的外生国际糖价每吨上涨500元，日产量高出样本一个标准差（4691吨）的糖厂，其单位利润相对于较小糖厂额外增加约32元。这种由规模驱动的盈利优势主要源于较低的非原材料成本，而非更高的销售价格或更高的生产率。本研究进一步识别了产能效应在所有制及主产区与非主产区之间的异质性，凸显了规模经济与地方政策干预的细微作用。这些发现为理解企业层面特征如何调节全球市场冲击的影响提供了新颖见解，并为优化资源依赖地区农产品加工效率提供了明确政策启示。

abstract: This paper examines the causal role of face-to-face (F2F) interactions in generating local informational advantages for mutual fund managers. Using COVID-19 lockdowns as an exogenous shock, I show that fund managers’ performance on local stocks declined relative to distant stocks when in-person meetings were curtailed, driven by impaired investment timing rather than changes in firm fundamentals. I investigate two distinct benefits of F2F interactions arising from interpersonal cues: trust-building, which enhances the transmission of soft information, and impression management, which facilitates the transmission of favorable information. The results cannot be fully explained by changes in internal information flows or the use of public information, and are more pronounced for stocks in less transparent information environments and in regions with stronger social traits.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了面对面（F2F）互动在共同基金经理获取本地信息优势中的因果作用。利用COVID-19封锁作为外生冲击，我发现当面对面会议受限时，基金经理在本地股票上的表现相对于远程股票有所下降，这一现象源于投资时机判断受损，而非公司基本面变化。我探究了面对面互动中人际线索带来的两个不同益处：信任构建，它增强了软信息的传递；以及印象管理，它促进了有利信息的传递。这些结果无法完全由内部信息流变化或公共信息使用来解释，并且在信息环境透明度较低及社会特征较强的地区更为显著。

abstract: This paper examines the optimal observability of Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) payment flows in the context of bank lending. Observability matters because lenders use borrowers' payment flows to enforce repayment, and the degree of visibility varies across payment instruments. When a CBDC is introduced alongside existing payment methods, we show that moderate observability in CBDC transactions may generate a pooling equilibrium that involves inefficient credit allocation. The optimal level of observability depends on how much CBDC increases entrepreneurs' revenues: When the benefit is modest, the socially optimal design is deposit‐like; when the benefit is large, it is cash‐like.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在银行贷款背景下，中央银行数字货币（CBDC）支付流的最优可观测性。可观测性之所以重要，是因为贷款人利用借款人的支付流来确保还款，而不同支付工具的可视程度各异。当CBDC与现有支付方式并行引入时，我们表明，CBDC交易中的适度可观测性可能产生一种涉及低效信贷配置的混合均衡。最优可观测性水平取决于CBDC对企业家收入的提升程度：当收益适中时，社会最优设计类似于存款；当收益较大时，则类似于现金。
